Catalogo.heroTitle: Every sheet of skin, an unrepeatable work.
Catalogo.heroBody: The Foolish Butcher crafts synthetic tattoo skins by hand, in small batches cared for one by one. Delivery times are slightly longer than industrial production — not out of inefficiency, but by choice. Every batch varies in consistency and tone: this is the secret that turns your clients into

pillars.p1body: Every sheet is hand-crafted in our workshop in small batches. We don't mass produce — and it shows.
pillars.p2body: Consistency and colour vary naturally from batch to batch. Your clients always tattoo on something slightly different.
pillars.p3body: A product that changes is a product that doesn't bore. Those who tattoo on Foolish come back to tattoo on Foolish again.

Catalogo.pmuDesc: Supports for Permanent Make-up — eyebrows, lips, eyeliner
Catalogo.kitDesc: Try our products before ordering in bulk — discounted and reserved for partners.
Catalogo.info1Body1: We don't work from stock. Every order is prepared as it arrives: skin is made daily, and each day we calibrate consistency and colour. You always receive a fresh product, never sitting on a shelf for months.
Catalogo.info1Body2: Because every skin is made to order and checked one by one, shipping takes on average around
Catalogo.info1Body3: : that is the time we need to craft it properly.
Catalogo.info1Body4: Every skin meets our highest production standards and is checked to be free of defects. Working by hand, something can occasionally slip through: in that case, replacement is immediate and guaranteed, no questions asked.
Catalogo.info2Title: What we can do for our trusted reseller
Catalogo.info2Body: We choose our resellers carefully, based on territory and regularity of reorders. By producing artisanally, we don't aim to cover every corner of the market: we prefer a few motivated partners who share our idea of quality.
Catalogo.info3Body1: Our products arrive with Foolish packaging. For many resellers this is added value: a recognisable brand helps sell and gives credibility to the product.
Catalogo.info3Body2: If you prefer to protect your direct relationship with end customers, we can work white label or customise the packaging to your needs. You decide how to present yourself — we'll discuss it and find the right formula.
